description: Source-linked baseline catalogue; documentation, not a runnable case manifest.
scope: Isolated benchmark candidates; ARM native and portable only; no x86 kernels or production integration.
line_number_basis: Current working tree; each location records an anchor and file SHA256. Regenerate links if sources move.

entries.contract: Same GF(2^128), native 16-byte layouts.
entries.secondary_comparison: Shared implementation. Compare against both consumers independently.
entries.coverage_note: 16 and 1,024 elements measured. Other sizes need direct F2Z/Flock comparisons.

entries.contract: Same GF(2^128), native 16-byte layouts.
entries.secondary_comparison: Shared implementation; ARM scalar_lanes. Compare against both consumers independently.
entries.coverage_note: 16 and 1,024 elements measured. Other sizes need direct F2Z/Flock comparisons.

entries.contract: Same GF(2^128), native 16-byte layouts.
entries.secondary_comparison: Shared implementation. Compare against both consumers independently.
entries.coverage_note: 16 and 1,024 elements measured. Other sizes need direct F2Z/Flock comparisons.

entries.contract: Same GF(2^128), native 16-byte layouts. Inverse uses nonzero inputs.
entries.secondary_comparison: Shared implementation. Compare against both consumers independently.
entries.coverage_note: 16 and 1,024 elements measured. Other sizes need direct F2Z/Flock comparisons.

entries.contract: XOR sum of unreduced products, one final field reduction.
entries.secondary_comparison: Retain shared_wide1 incumbent and eager Flock as a secondary comparison.
entries.coverage_note: Existing F2Z delayed arithmetic is the primary baseline; eager multiplication alone is weaker.

entries.contract: Same scalar/product or pair butterfly; scalar is explicitly public and fixed for the pass.
entries.secondary_comparison: Benchmark actual private FixedGfMul through a frozen extraction; retain existing prepared formula as a control.
entries.coverage_note: Actual private FixedGfMul and prepared-formula controls are now measured for zero/half/full scalars, at 16/1024/65536. Dedicated actual-constructor timing is still separate work.

entries.operation: GF128/B127 fused sumcheck rounds and folds
entries.contract: Identical weighted coefficients and output buffers; a weighted pair is not one multiplication.
entries.secondary_comparison: Generic unfused formula is a diagnostic; actual native fused hooks are the regression baseline.
entries.coverage_note: GF128 single/two-pair, fused fold-round and pending-two grid hooks measured with matched resets. B127 fused hooks and standalone Flock slice fold remain separate work.

entries.contract: Same source offset, destination length and output layout.
entries.secondary_comparison: F2Z in-place fold is a separate lifecycle, not a direct timing denominator.
entries.coverage_note: Add an isolated wrapper; portable versus native on ARM only.

entries.contract: AES polynomial basis; nonzero inverse domain for current measurements.
entries.secondary_comparison: Existing ARM vector GF8 multiplication, exposed separately through a frozen wrapper, is a stronger batch control.
entries.coverage_note: Scalar and existing ARM vector batch multiplication, and a new vector inverse chain are measured. Exhaustive byte correctness includes zero; inverse is totalized to zero as in Flock.

entries.contract: GF(2^127) modulo X^127+X+1; high padding bit canonical.
entries.secondary_comparison: Retain existing mul_karatsuba and mul_pfold as controls; all have the same field contract.
entries.coverage_note: Existing multiplication, Karatsuba and polynomial-fold controls compared. The native implementation remains faster; existing square/inverse metrics remain valid.

entries.contract: Benchmark Boolean and F2 contracts separately; integer bit lifting is not a field embedding into odd characteristic.
entries.secondary_comparison: Native bool/u64 packed operations as controls after matching lane and output contracts.
entries.coverage_note: Add measured loops and output checks; one scalar bit and a packed word are not equivalent work units.

entries.operation: Packed F2 polynomial multiply and dot
entries.contract: Full carryless product with W_OUT >= W_A+W_B; no field reduction.
entries.secondary_comparison: Bit-serial oracle outside timing; current native and portable product schedules as timed controls.
entries.coverage_note: Dense/sparse fixed-schedule dot products compared with production zero skipping at widths 1x1, 3x7 and 9x9. Standalone product timing remains separate work.

entries.operation: GF8 to GF128 embedding and explicit lifts
entries.contract: Exact existing embedding basis; zero extension is not phi8.
entries.secondary_comparison: Fixed-address basis combination against current table embedding; classify private timing contract separately.
entries.coverage_note: GF8-to-GF128 fixed-address basis combination compared with existing table embedding at 16/1024/65536. Other lifts are not covered by this measurement.

entries.contract: Same exponent capacity/pattern, base reuse and output field.
entries.secondary_comparison: Individual power and prepared FixedBasePow are separate public-input baselines.
entries.coverage_note: Existing fixed-base code is variable-time; do not certify a private fixed-schedule candidate by comparison with that path alone.

entries.contract: Arithmetic modulo 2^(64L); bounded fixtures may additionally have exact mathematical results.
entries.secondary_comparison: Keep the winning two_limb_mac/selected and nine-limb fused kernel in every relevant development comparison.
entries.coverage_note: Wrapping MAC widths 1/2/4/9, full-width and signed16 fixtures, old incumbents and new four-limb native schedule measured; add/sub comparisons included.

entries.contract: Existing Option values include success/failure representation and mixed overflow classes.
entries.secondary_comparison: Raw crypto-bigint CtOption checked operations for masked private-result comparisons; keep Option API timing separate.
entries.coverage_note: Checked signed/unsigned add/sub candidates compared at widths 1/2/4/9. Checked multiplication retains prior metrics; Option comparisons are not a private-result timing certification.

entries.contract: Ordering, equality masks and selection are separate output contracts.
entries.secondary_comparison: Native comparisons for 1/2 limbs; direct raw signed/unsigned masked operations for matching Ct results.
entries.coverage_note: Only unsigned Ordering loop is measured. Add signed comparison, CtEq/CtOrd/CtSelect and bit operations.

entries.operation: Integer shifts, bitwise operations and narrowing
entries.contract: Public versus private shift amounts and checked versus unchecked conversion are separate cases.
entries.secondary_comparison: Raw crypto-bigint operations and primitive controls at matching width.
entries.coverage_note: Add measured cases; no dynamic-width trimming from secret values.

baseline_sources.label: crypto-bigint 0.7.5 widening_mul
baseline_sources.anchor: pub const fn widening_mul<const RHS_LIMBS: usize>

entries.contract: All 2L output limbs, identical layout and no reduction.
entries.secondary_comparison: Existing P-256 product is a separate 18-limb-output comparison; do not compare its time to a shorter output without accounting for writes.
entries.coverage_note: Exact products at widths 1/2/4/9, asymmetric 2x9, and 2048/4096 bits are measured against crypto-bigint. The generic schoolbook candidate loses at large widths.

entries.contract: Four or nine public active limbs in nine-limb storage; all 18 output limbs written.
entries.secondary_comparison: Compare with prepared_selected and validate_execute_selected from integer-focus-arm-03, plus raw widening multiplication at matching output width.
entries.coverage_note: Public-bound preparation and execution have separate timings. Existing value-scanning baseline is not a private fixed-schedule implementation.

entries.operation: Exact signed/mixed products and exact MAC

entries.contract: A+B product limbs, A+B+1 accumulator limbs; bounded total product count.
entries.secondary_comparison: Build a fixed-storage product-then-add reference; BigInt remains an independent oracle outside timing.
entries.coverage_note: Exact signed/unsigned MACs with an extra accumulator limb measured at 2/4/9 limbs, including sign conversion in the reference. Mixed signed/unsigned products remain separate work.

baseline_sources.anchor: pub const fn div_rem_vartime<const RHS_LIMBS: usize>

entries.contract: Same quotient and remainder, divisor public for preparation; normalization/output padding included when required.
entries.secondary_comparison: For 64-bit divisors compare prepared reciprocal; for public multi-limb divisors also compare div_rem_vartime, documented variable only in divisor.
entries.coverage_note: Generic, public-divisor, prepared-reciprocal and batch-preparation comparisons now measured for 64-bit divisors through 4096-bit numerators. Multi-limb prepared divisor and signed division remain separate work.

baseline_sources.label: Signed truncating division
baseline_sources.anchor: pub const fn checked_div_rem<const RHS_LIMBS: usize>

entries.contract: Truncation toward zero, signed remainder, MIN/-1 and zero-divisor validity.
entries.secondary_comparison: Public-divisor variant separately; distinguish truncating remainder from canonical modular reduction.
entries.coverage_note: Add benchmark wrapper with matching validity output. Do not use unsigned division or floor division as the denominator.

entries.contract: Canonical nonnegative residue of the same signed integer; q100/q128 and widths 2/4/9.
entries.secondary_comparison: Fixed-storage crypto-bigint vartime division is an additional control, not an owned replacement.
entries.coverage_note: Fixed-width signed Horner reduction measured at q100/q128, widths 2/4/9, including preparation, prepared reuse and one-shot calls. Frozen ARM correction uses CtSelect. Fixtures are predominantly full-width, not tiny relation coefficients.

entries.contract: Reduced Montgomery residues and same public modulus; compact versus configured layouts explicitly identified.
entries.secondary_comparison: RawMontyCtx is the primary compact arithmetic baseline; configured MontyField and invariant-brand wrappers remain controls.
entries.coverage_note: Multiplication measured; add/sub/neg/square/division need their own timings. Shared Fq inverse/pow/div stubs are not baselines.

entries.operation: Prime product and native linear MAC
entries.contract: Field×field has R² scale, field×native integer has R scale; preserve the appropriate final reduction.
entries.secondary_comparison: Keep one accumulator and acc4; small and large batches choose no winner until confirmation.
entries.coverage_note: One accumulator, four accumulators and public batch-length dispatch measured at q100/q128 and 16/1024/65536 terms. Small batches remain independently gated.

entries.contract: One reduction of an accumulator constructed from 1,024 terms, not 1,024 reductions.
entries.secondary_comparison: Crypto-bigint reference is retained as a slower control.
entries.coverage_note: Optimized existing reducer is the primary baseline.

entries.contract: Existing helper requires coefficient magnitude <= u64::MAX despite an i128 argument.
entries.secondary_comparison: For larger signed coefficients build a matching full-width reference; do not reinterpret a full-width unsigned Montgomery residue as signed.
entries.coverage_note: Add a timed wrapper for the actual bounded helper; general signed coefficient accumulation needs a new reference.

entries.contract: Nonzero elements for current loop; masked zero/nonunit outputs receive separate tests and timings.
entries.secondary_comparison: Benchmark existing FixedMontyForm::invert as the matching private-input API control, plus prepared SafeGcdInverter reuse.
entries.coverage_note: Existing variable-time independent inversions measured; CT control, prepared inversion and division need timings.

baseline_sources.label: Existing bounded exponentiation
baseline_sources.anchor: pub const fn pow_bounded_exp<const RHS_LIMBS: usize>

entries.contract: Identical exponent value, public bit bound, field and base reuse.
entries.secondary_comparison: Prepared fixed-base candidate gets distinct setup and repeated-execution comparisons.
entries.coverage_note: Public binary exponentiation compared with bounded window exponentiation at sparse 17-bit and alternating 127-bit public exponents. Private exponent and fixed-base preparation are not covered.

entries.contract: One shared inversion; current helper leaves zeros zero and allocates prefix/output buffers.
entries.secondary_comparison: Compare equivalent allocating calls, then separate scratch-reuse implementations with preparation cost reported.
entries.coverage_note: Actual production one-inversion routine compared with configured-output compact allocated candidates; separate compact scratch reuse. Nonzero, mixed and all-zero q100/q128 fixtures included. Masking has a measurable cost on zeros.

entries.contract: Known public prime; setup includes Montgomery constants and RawMontyCtx, not prime search.
entries.secondary_comparison: Raw reuse measured separately from fresh construction.
entries.coverage_note: Known q127 measured; additional widths/moduli need coverage. Prime selection is lower priority.

entries.contract: Canonical standard residues, not raw Montgomery words; match width and validation.
entries.secondary_comparison: Allocating wrapper and whole proof framing are separate baselines; private masked decoding needs a matching result contract.
entries.coverage_note: Current timings are preallocated conversion components only.

entries.contract: Exact declared width/endianness, signed representation and padding-bit validation.
entries.secondary_comparison: Raw copy controls measure transport only; retain canonical-validation and allocation costs in their own comparisons.
entries.coverage_note: Correctness checks exist, but dedicated complete codec timings are still needed.

entries.contract: Identical transform shape, lane order, thread counts and reset lifecycle.
entries.secondary_comparison: Keep native fused schedule primary; generic/scalar transforms are correctness or diagnostic controls.
entries.coverage_note: Complete reset-plus-transform comparisons through log18 with 32 lanes; one and ten caller threads measured. Setup is outside these timings. Parallel recommendations remain shape-specific.

entries.operation: Hybrid OOD evaluation and packed-buffer lifecycle
entries.contract: Identical packed layout/point, final field value and lifecycle; separate evaluation, packing, and composite costs.
entries.secondary_comparison: Keep current blocked delayed-reduction evaluation; naive per-element multiplication is not the primary speed baseline.
entries.coverage_note: Real blocked OOD evaluation, scratch reuse, packing and packing-plus-OOD measured at one and ten threads. The packed Vec is retained for the later consumer; grinding and the later opening proof are excluded.

baseline_sources.anchor: pub const fn div_rem<const RHS_LIMBS: usize>

entries.contract: Canonical residues for explicit odd/even/composite moduli; nonunits produce invalid inverse results.
entries.secondary_comparison: Build fixed-storage add/mul/reduce reference compositions for absent owned-ring APIs.
entries.coverage_note: Prime-field timings do not establish composite/even-modulus coverage. No dedicated ring benchmark is wired yet.
